text: /dream: consolidating sleep that remembers since the last dream
description: MCP prompt /mcp__aimparency__dream, usable in every Aimparency project. It recalls the window since the newest "Dream:" reflection (fallback: 14 days of .bowman git history), consolidates it into at most 5 lessons, dreams from the ideas carrying intrinsic value (love = what is valued for its own sake), and wakes with "I just woke up from dreaming, here is what I remember:". It always records its memory as a reflection on the top root; other graph mutations need writeBack=true. Commit 7678a8a.

status.comment: Prompt reworked and tested (prompts.test.ts, pnpm check 25/25). Needs /mcp reconnect, then a first dream run by Felix to accept.
